title: 建築安全工学
subtitle: Architectural Safety Engineering
keywords: matrix method 2.plastic analysis 3.seismic design 4.vibration theory 5.foundation structure
educationalGoal: Apply the knowledge of building structural mechanics and general building structure to learn basic knowledge of structural design in the following;(1) Matrix method for calculating the stress of a rigid frame, (2) Plastic analysis for calculating the strength of buildings, (3) Vibration theory that treats external disturbances such as earthquakes and winds as dynamic external forces, (4) Seismic isolation and basics of seismic control, (5) Foundation structure.
advice: This course focuses on practical work and applies the knowledge of basic structural fields learned; (1) Stress analysis premised on calculation by computer (matrix method) (2) Plastic analysis that is the basis for constructing a mechanism to safely plasticize a building under an excessive external force (3) History of seismic design and vibration theory as the basis of dynamic design (4) Basics of the foundation structure that safely supports buildings
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics, structural mechanics, and architectural structure is required, and related subjects are as follows.Mathematics: Linear Algebra Ⅰ (1st term), Linear Algebra Ⅱ (2nd term), Function / Derivative (1st term), Integral / Differential Equation (2nd term), Architectural Mathematics (2nd term) Structural Mechanics: Architectural Structural Mechanics II (2nd term), Architectural Structural Mechanics 1 (3rd term)General building structure: Steel structure (5th term), reinforced concrete structure (5th term), General architectural engineering exercise A (5th term)

activityGoals.body: Students can perform stress analysis of truss structure and frame structure by the direct stiffness method.
Students understand the basics of plastic analysis and determine the collapse load of a simple frame structure.
Students can explain the history of seismic design and the current concept of seismic design.
Students understand the vibration theory and can explain response spectrum.
Students understand the foundation structure and can explain outline the foundation design.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・ Understand the basics of elasticity theory and explain the process of deriving the basic analysis formula for a plane frame. ・ Explain the analysis result of the plane frame. ・ Understand the concept of plastic analysis and explain the collapse conditions. ・ The collapse load of the frame structure can be obtained from the mechanism method and the plastic moment-distribution method. ・ Explain the concept of seismic design and basic physical quantities for understanding vibration phenomena, and can calculate practically. ・ Eexplain outline the foundation design.
achievementLevels.standard: ・ Explain the analysis result of the plane frame. ・ Understand the concept of plastic analysis and explain the collapse conditions. ・ The collapse load of beams and small frames can be obtained from the mechanism method and the plastic moment-distribution method. ・ Explain basic physical quantities for understanding vibration phenomena and calculate practically. ・ Understand foundation structure and explain basic terms.
